gold_note: Sauropod strict consensus. Eight clade names are kept as internal labels: Neosauropoda, Diplodocoidea, Titanosauriformes, Titanosauria and Lithostrotia at open node circles, and Macronaria, Brachiosauridae and Somphospondyli at arcs on the stems of their nodes.
